Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified "Lockheed Martin" as the developer of the ASM-N-5 Gorgon V in one of the search results shown in step 2. Despite other sources consistently stating that the missile was developed by the Glenn L. Martin Company, WebSurfer did not resolve the discrepancy or clarify the conflicting information. This could have led to confusion in subsequent steps, as the incorrect attribution to Lockheed Martin was not explicitly addressed or corrected. Although the ultimate answer provided was correct (Martin Marietta), the failure to address the conflicting data could have impacted the accuracy and reliability of the solution.
